_what: Messages shown at the top of the Zuri testers' list. This branch is edited directly, so a note reaches the squad without shipping code or merging anything. The app fetches it from raw.githubusercontent.com, which caches for about 5 minutes.
_fields: id (unique, never reuse) · title · text (plain words, no HTML) · until (YYYY-MM-DD, hidden after this day) · from

notices.title: Veronicah found a real one — and it is already fixed
notices.text:
When you typed a customer's name into the search box, letters were being thrown away, and deleting fought back. Veronicah reported it at 8:36 this morning and it is fixed and live now.

That is the job: not finishing steps, but finding what does not work and saying so plainly. Keep them coming — including the small ones and the "this is probably just me" ones.

Asante sana.
